mapper.insert: INSERT INTO rag_eval_runs (run_id, retriever, started_at, completed_at, top_k, hit_rate, recall, `precision`, mrr, case_count, details_json) VALUES (#{runId}, #{retriever}, #{startedAt}, #{completedAt}, #{topK}, #{hitRate}, #{recall}, #{precision}, #{mrr}, #{caseCount}, #{detailsJson}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE retriever = VALUES(retriever), started_at = VALUES(started_at), completed_at = VALUES(completed_at), top_k = VALUES(top_k), hit_rate = VALUES(hit_rate), recall = VALUES(recall), `precision` = VALUES(`precision`), mrr = VALUES(mrr), case_count = VALUES(case_count), details_json = VALUES(details_json)
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM rag_eval_runs WHERE retriever = #{retriever} ORDER BY started_at DESC, run_id DESC LIMIT 1
